thread:
maria-ops: Heads up — tiny agenda shuffle for today's all-hands at 11. Can the AV folks confirm stream + recording status?

devon: On it. Obs just did a weird drop in the last rehearsal, will validate scenes now.

sanjay: What changed in the agenda? need to adjust Q&A order.

lina: Leadership asked to move roadmap 2 -> 1, so timeline Q&A should be earlier.

maria-ops: Yep — roadmap first 15m, then product demos, then ops updates. Also capture a separate clip of the roadmap segment for socials.

alex: Recording bot shows last job successful but RTMP handshake had a 502 once, might be related to encoder CPU spike.

recording-bot: automated notice: last_recording_job=2026-03-23T09:34:02Z status=completed duration=00:42:17 artifacts=/artifacts/allhands-rehearsal.mp4

devon: Rehearsal log: "OBS -> RTMP: handshake timeout" at 09:34, encoder cpu 95% for ~8s. Re-running with lower canvas res.

sanjay: Can we fallback to cloud encoder if OBS hits cpu? that's what we used last quarter.

lina: Yes — fallback policy is enabled but needs manual toggle. maria-ops, want me to hold the toggle during the event?

maria-ops: Please. If we see >2 dropped frames in 30s switch to cloud encoder and record local backup.

alex: Also captions ingest endpoint returned 429 during rehearsal — rate limit bump requested. pinged infra.

devon: Quick checklist I pushed to #eng-sre: ```1) confirm stream key 2) set OBS scene 'allhands-final' 3) enable cloud-fallback toggle 4) start local recording 5) check captions endpoint```.

maria-ops: thanks. Can someone post the stream key again? I rotated it this morning.

lina: posted in 1:1 — will repost to the secure channel.

sanjay: For Q&A: we'll accept questions from Slack thread + live room. Who's moderating?

maria-ops: alex will moderate Slack Qs, devon will collect on-room mics. We'll keep 10m at end for open questions.

alex: I'll pull the pinned prompt and surface high-priority questions to the CEO. Also setting a visual cue in slides when we're doing live Qs.

devon: Small fix — scene transition timing needs to be 600ms, not 200ms; fast transitions caused dropped frames in rehearse.

maria-ops: noted. devon, can you bake that into the scene transitions and confirm by 10:50?

devon: Will do.

alex: One more — please make sure we record a separate high-bit-rate clip of roadmap for marketing (no captions burned). Set `ffmpeg -i rtmp://... -c:v libx264 -b:v 8M -preset fast out-roadmap.mp4`.

recording-bot: note: retention-policy=30d for stream-recordings. Request a 90d retention for roadmap clip? reply with approval.

maria-ops: Approved for 90d. lina, can you ensure upload to marketing bucket after event?

lina: Yup, will move and drop a link in the thread when done.

sanjay: A few leadership Qs were sent pre-meeting about Dedicated SLAs and Private deployment timing — want to flag to leadership so they can prep answers.

maria-ops: Passed to CEO and Head of Product. They'll have 2 slides and 3 talking points.

devon: Final ask: if we see encoder CPU >85% during live, trigger cloud fallback immediately; I'll add an alert to dashboard.

alex: I'll monitor Slack Qs and feed them to the MC. If anything breaks, ping me @here. :thumbsup:

maria-ops: Great — thanks everyone. See you at 10:55 for final checks.
